mass.provenance: code:physics.js (0.45 kg solid steel; r = 0.05*cup_ri * ratio, ratio 0.60 @ 0.45 kg, 0.80 @ 0.60 kg — ball diameter maps to 60-80% of 100 mm cup bore)

release.note: arm releases at rest_angle -1.00 rad (hard stop); launch angle ~31 deg is tuned to hit the pyramid and deviates from the geometric tangent release (~39.8 deg). Fitted per skill provenance rules: the demo is 'demonstration grade' for this aspect.

inputs.range_provenance: code:physics.js/trebuchet.js slider min 1.40 max 4.00 default 2.60 (sand full = 4.0 kg; lower bound keeps release from stalling)

fitted_quantities_in_current_project.note: chosen for pyramid-hit tuning; geometric tangent release would be ~39.8 deg. See mechanism.release.provenance. (pre-V2 speed/angle/accel formulas at main.js:454/455/416 were removed from fire() in v0.0.3)

fitted_quantities_in_current_project.value: 0.60 (0.45 kg) - 0.80 (0.60 kg) of the 100 mm cup bore
fitted_quantities_in_current_project.note: visual-fit mapping between ball mass and diameter; sliders bounded by cup bore

ball_stand.feature: cannonball starts on a wooden stand (paper lower-left, in FRONT of the trebuchet, clear of the counterweight swing and the block scatter zone); clicking the ball OR its stand loads it into the cup
ball_stand.balance_mode: on load, unlockBalance() frees the arm hinge — the beam settles like a seesaw under real ball-vs-counterweight torque; heavy cw settles onto the chassis, heavy ball tips cup-down to the logical ~45 deg stop (no embed)
ball_stand.gates: Fire is disabled (hint shown) until a ball is loaded; after a shot the fresh ball returns to the stand; slider changes while loaded re-settle the balance
ball_stand.tour: 9 steps: READ/LIFT/MODEL/WOOD/PARTS/LOAD/FIRE/REPLAY/BUILD; LOAD animates the ball from the stand into the cup
ball_stand.provenance: code: main.js (createBallStand/loadBall/updateBallInCup/ballLoaded), physics.js (unlockBalance), index.html (9 tour steps); measured in browser (load->fire default 3.53 m/s, range 1.61 m)
